G3575940.description: Willikies (/wɪlɪkiːz/) is a small settlement in the parish of Saint Philip, located in the eastern part of Antigua island in Antigua and Barbuda. It is located to the north of Nonsuch Bay, between Seatons and Indian Town Point.

G3575956.description: Urlings is a village in Saint Mary, and the twenty-sixth largest settlement in Antigua and Barbuda. Urlings is located in the southwest of Antigua and has a history dating to before 1856.

G3575975.description: Swetes (/swiːts/) is a village located in Saint Paul Parish on the island of Antigua, in Antigua and Barbuda. The village had a population of 1,308 in 2011 and covered a land area of 4.09 square kilometres.

G3576004.description: Sea View Farm is a village located in Saint George on the island of Antigua, in Antigua and Barbuda. Sea View Farm had a population of 792 in 2011 over 1.07 square kilometres.

G3576022.description: St. John's (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Jaan) is the largest city in Antigua and Barbuda.

G3576050.description: Potters Village is a village located on Antigua in Antigua and Barbuda. It is located in the north of the island, to the east of the capital, St.

G3576057.description: Piggotts, also known as St Mark's Village, is a village in Saint George Parish on Antigua island in Antigua and Barbuda. It had a population of 1,478 in 2001.

G3576074.description: Parham (/pɑːɹʊm/; North Antiguan: Paarum), officially known as the Town of Parham, is the capital of Saint Peter, the largest city in Saint Peter, and the fourteenth largest city in Antigua and Barbuda. Parham's population was 1,307 in 2011, distributed over 1.99 square kilometres.

G3576075.description: Pares is a small village in central Antigua. it is located to the north of Potworks Dam and south of the town of Parham on the Sir Robin Yearwood Highway between Vernons and Willikies.

G3576085.description: Old Road (South Antiguan: Hol' Roud [(h)ɔl roʊd]), officially known as the Town of Old Road, is a town located on a roadstead in the parish of Saint Mary, Antigua and Barbuda. It is overlooked by Boggy Peak, which lies to its northwest.

G3576144.description: Liberta is a village located in Saint Paul, Antigua and Barbuda It had a population of 2,003 in 2011 over 3.94 square kilometres. Established in 1834 by freed slaves, it the fourth-largest village on Antigua.

G3576160.description: Jennings is a small settlement in Saint Mary Parish on the island of Antigua, in Antigua and Barbuda. It is located in the west of the island.

G3576214.description: Grays Hill is a village in Saint John, Antigua and Barbuda. It had a population of 542 people in 2011.

G3576236.description: Freetown is a village in Antigua. It is located in the southeast of the island, on a peninsula between Willoughby Bay to the south and Nonsuch Bay to the north.

G3576260.description: Falmouth (/fɑːlməθ/; North Antiguan: Faamat [fäːmət]) is a coastal port town located in Saint Paul Parish on the island of Antigua, in Antigua and Barbuda. The town is located in the south of the island, at the end of Falmouth Harbour.

G3576264.description: English Harbour (North Antiguan: Inglish Aaba) is a natural harbour and settlement on the island of Antigua in the Caribbean, in the extreme south of the island. The settlement takes its name from the nearby harbour in which the Royal Navy established its base of operations for the area during the eighteenth century.

G3576311.description: Codrington (Barbudan Creole: Kaadringtin) is the only village on the island of Barbuda, which is part of the country of Antigua and Barbuda. Codrington coincides with the Codrington major division, one of the two major divisions on Barbuda.

G3576338.description: Cedar Grove is a settlement in the far north of the island of Antigua. It is located to the east of the island's northernmost headlands, Boon Point.

G3576344.description: Carlisle is a village in Saint George Parish, Antigua and Barbuda.

G3576361.description: Bolans (South Antiguan: Bolan) is the largest settlement in Saint Mary, Antigua and Barbuda. Located south of Jennings on Valley Road, the once agrarian community has since been transformed into the economic centre of Saint Mary, as well as one of the largest tourist destinations in the country in the Jolly Harbour neighbourhood.

G3576378.description: Bendals is a village in Saint John, Antigua and Barbuda. It is located in the Bendals Valley near the former village of St.

G3576397.description: All Saints is the second largest settlement in Antigua and Barbuda, with a population of 3,829 as of 2011. It is located at the intersection of three parishes in Antigua's Central Plain, 8.6 kilometres southeast of the largest city, St.

G6695166.description: Jolly Harbour (South Antiguan Creole: Jaali Aaba) is a neighbourhood in Bolans, Saint Mary, Antigua and Barbuda. It began as a commercial development in the 1980s and has since grown to hold one of the largest expatriate populations on the island.
